title: 1988 Topps MLB Baseball Sticker Album - Empty & Unused
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 1988 Topps MLB Baseball Sticker Album is a collectible item featuring unused baseball stickers from the 1985 season. This vintage album by Topps includes stickers representing players from Major League Baseball, making it a must-have for fans and collectors of baseball memorabilia. The empty album provides a unique opportunity to add a piece of baseball history to your collection and enjoy the nostalgia of baseball in the 1980s.
